class_id: integration test files pass in isolation and fail only under the runner's file-level parallelism, because they share look-alike fixture rows on the same test database
symptom: two test files each build their own fixture rows that look alike (same shape, overlapping identifiers or state), and each passes correctly when run alone. Vitest's default file-level parallelism runs both against the SAME test database at once, so one file's fixture mutation is visible to the other mid-test, producing a wrong assertion outcome (e.g. an enum-like status read as 'bound' when the test expected 'held') that only appears in the full, CI-equivalent invocation -- never when the file is run by itself, which is how a developer normally verifies a fix before pushing.
first_seen: 2026-09-26 -- #252/#1209. `identity-matching-od68.integration.test.ts` and `source-record-keys-od85.integration.test.ts` both PASS alone and FAIL together with the other 51 integration files under the CI-equivalent `npx vitest run -c vitest.integration.config.ts` invocation against ipodhan_test.
fix_prs: #1209 (closes #252): config-level isolation for the two racing files (so their fixtures no longer collide under parallel execution); separately, `consolidation-dedup.integration.test.ts`'s stale `cannot-run-in-ci` exclusion (fixed 2026-09-11 to use DATABASE_URL but never re-included) was moved into the CI run list, and `nse-subscription.integration.test.ts`'s exclusion reason was updated with a live-NSE measurement (31/32 assertions pass against ipodhan_test; 1 fails only on live NSE data shape, correctly excluded).
detection_check: the full 54-file integration run itself, now with the two fixed files included/isolated -- a green run of the CI-equivalent invocation is the check. No isolated per-file-vs-full-run diff check exists yet as a standing detector for a NEW instance of this class.
